content: Photo-analysis products need user-visible asynchronous state rather than an indefinitely open request. A durable pattern is queued, validating, processing, ready/completed, and failed, with progress or a clear stage message, a stale-job timeout/watchdog, safe retry, and preservation of uploaded inputs. PhotoPick illustrates per-file upload states and an explicit transition from processing to a retryable error after a bounded wait; queue guidance emphasizes durable job ownership, bounded concurrency, lease expiry, safe retries, attempt history, and a final error class. This aligns with SukatAI existing processing fields and the requirement that prior durable results not be deleted before a replacement is committed. Sources: https://kb.photopick.net/en/nahravani/stav-zpracovani-a-chyby ; https://www.prowebsolutions.de/en/insights/parallel-workers-queues-image-analysis/
